name: TOB Bible Event
description: One Bible event (e.g. The Creation, The Exodus, Pentecost). Admin-authored content, browsed by every logged-in user via truth_of_bible.api.bible_events (never raw REST for a normal user — same closed-permission-table pattern as TOB Bible Place).

fields.label: Era
fields.options:
Creation & Patriarchs
Exodus & Wilderness
Kings & Prophets
Life of Jesus
Early Church
fields.description: Groups events on the browse screen; the app picks the era's color/icon client-side.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Only Published events are ever returned to the app.

fields.label: Sort Order
fields.description: Lower shows first within its era on the browse screen.

fields.label: Relevant Passages
fields.description: One Bible reference per line (e.g. "Genesis 1:1"), shown as tappable passages when this event comes up in search.
